items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No mention of the interviewee (Billy McBride) in relation to Buzzy; Buzzy is mentioned only as the interviewer's brother.

ctx.x: Is he still here? He's here somewhere. He was on South Parkway the last time I heard from him. I saw him. Buzzy saw him, my brother. Yeah. You see, my brother, he knows, see everybody from home.
I wish I could find him sometime and interview him. I won't be able to do this trip, I suppose, but next trip, maybe.
